baseline.description: No change: keep the current setup
baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a turbo thruster kit. The product of CBP ruling N362414, as its facts describe it. The turbo thruster kit is assembled in Canada using components sourced from China, United States, Malaysia and Canada.

The silicone boot, bolts, backplate, compressor cover, turbine housing, turbine wheel, actuator, heat shield and bearing housing are produced in China. The clamp are sourced from United States. The compressor wheel are sourced from Malaysia. The rod end are produced in Canada. 

Final assembly in Canada: assemble the parts into the finished good.

Tariff classifications given with the product (HTSUS; the product's own codes, not verified by CBP): the turbo thruster kit (the finished good), 8414.59.3000; the silicone boot (made in China), 3926.90.99; the clamp (made in United States), 7326.90; the bolts (made in China), 7318.15; the backplate (made in China), 8414.90.41; the compressor wheel (made in Malaysia), 8414.90.41; the compressor cover (made in China), 8414.90.41; the turbine housing (made in China), 8414.90.41; the turbine wheel (made in China), 8414.90.41; the rod end (made in Canada), 8414.90.41; the actuator (made in China), 8414.90.41; the heat shield (made in China), 8414.90.41; the bearing housing (made in China), 8414.90.41.

prediction.decisive_step: Final assembly of the components into the turbo thruster kit in Canada
prediction.reasoning: Under 19 CFR 102.20, subheading 8414.59 requires a change from any other subheading. All foreign materials are classified in 3926.90, 7318.15, 7326.90, or 8414.90, so each satisfies the tariff shift when assembled in Canada under 102.11(a)(3).
